posts.body: It doesn't answer your question but I bought a TENS machine 2nd hand on ebay and bought new electrodes from Amazon and it actually worked out cheaper than hiring. Also, I didn't have to worry about getting it returned on time once the baby came, it was ready weeks in advance if he'd come early, I've been able to lend it to friends since then and I still have the option of re-using it if there was another baby or selling it on ebay to get most of my money back.

posts.body:
When I went into labour with my DS last year, the midwife led unit I was meant to have him gave me one to use, they had several there, and since they only have 2-3 women there at the time it was ok for me to use it (helped tremendously during the 36 hour labour). Where are you planning to have your baby? It might be worth seeing if they have them on site for you to use so you don't have to pay for hiring one for weeks beforehand. If not, I agree with buying one, I have noticed some on local facebook selling sites selling for about £5, you would need new electrodes but still cheaper than hiring one. That's what I'm looking to do for DS2 due in November. 

Laura x

posts.body:
Don't hire - buy & plan to lend or sell on. Works out cheaper, less stressful and it's there for future babies, stinking backache, any time you want pain relief without pills.

Check replacement electrodes are easily available for your chosen make & model before you buy!

All the best!

posts.body:
I was recommended the following by my midwife:

http://www.babycaretens.com/acatalog/Femme_TENS.html

They are discontinuing this particular model for one that looks a little different, and so it's half price (and so is the same price as hiring).

I haven't used it yet (due in three weeks!), but they're the ones used by my hospital, and like I said, was recommended by my midwife. It's got a range of settings and a boost button for contractions so hopefully should be good. Apparently they;re only selling at this price until they run out though...

I plan on selling it after labour so should hopefully make some money back too.

Hope to help
